subject: Segmenting "real" transect lines, i.e not very straight and containing MULTILINESTRINGs

messages.author: 9ed807cc28efa7a6
messages.subject: Segmenting "real" transect lines, i.e not very straight and containing MULTILINESTRINGs
parts:
Hi everyone, 

I am trying to segment survey effort transect lines into smaller portions (e.g 4km). To do so, I am following the examples provided there: `dsm` data formatting example (distancesampling.org) 
However, when plotting the segment length histogram, I get most segments around 40m instead of 4000m. My guess is that because the line is built from GPS points collected every 10 seconds (~40m), then it is angled a little at each point, never perfectly straight, and then the function start a new segment every time the line is angled.
Is there a way to go around this, is it possible to include multiple linestrings into a same segment ?

I hope my explanation are somewhat clear,

Thanks in advance for any advice you may have,

Morgane
